newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises led again by SPT Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises led again by SPT Telecom.

text.p: The Czech PX50 rose 0.65 percent to 607.4 on Tuesday boosted once more by strong gains from the index's most heavily capitalised share SPT Telecom.

After Tuesday's 50 crown rise SPT now stands just 70 crowns below the 4,000 threshold but dealers said that the issue's recent surge -- SPT has risen 15 percent since the beginning of 1997 -- had been partly built on low liquidity trading and warned that investors may soon be tempted to take profits.
"Liquidity has really been much lower than in January. I think if some supply appeared some investors could be thinking of taking profits," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.

The strength of SPT's rise was almost matched by the index's biggest banking stock Komercni Banka which gained 50 crowns to 2,700. Bajgar also said that there had been low liquidity in Komercni throughout Tuesday's session.
Generally, analysts say that blue chips have been boosted by growing confidence in the bourse's ability to improve transparency in the notoriously opaque Czech equities market.

On Tuesday, the bourse said it would force exchange members to disclose a range of off-market trades within 24 hours at the latest after a deal has been made. The move should come into effect on April 1.
